```{r}

library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(ordered)

titanic <- read_csv("data/titanic.csv")

titanic <- titanic %>%
  mutate(
    class_sex = paste(Pclass, Sex, sep = "-")
  )
```
